purpose: Finite review evidence contract over the existing NMI acceptance plan. No adapter, provider simulation or authority is created.
evidenceRule: Every operational gate is UNVERIFIED. Local tests, source hashes, synthetic receipts and this contract cannot satisfy genuine operational evidence. Gate order never authorizes its actions.
privateEvidenceRule: Actual merchant/account/bank/target/user/token identifiers and raw evidence stay in separately approved private custody; only a sanitized review reference, observed time, scope digest and independent reviewer outcome belong in a future public status.
unknownRule: Preserve the exact original intent, key, amount and source. UNKNOWN permits exact independently authorized read-only reconciliation only; no replay, replacement key, changed amount, fallback provider or automatic continuation.

gates.name: Current local source and containment review
requiredEvidence: Independent exact-SHA review of existing reserve/finish/inbox/observation/reconciliation
Default-OFF routes and execution controls independently confirmed
gates.exit: Reviewed local evidence only; no operational permission

gates.name: Per-company sandbox merchant and settlement ownership

Independent evidence of account control, processor/acquirer and authorized settlement recipient
Currency/rail entitlement, funding/report availability, timezone/cutoff and fee/refund/dispute policy
gates.exit: Account availability never implies ready merchant, token or bank settlement

gates.name: Genuine authority and restricted operational custody
requiredEvidence: Current genuine Auth/MFA and exact invoice/customer/merchant authority
Provider-hosted origin and source-bound immutable token consumption
Dedicated restricted TLS identity, exact grants and bounded workload
Reviewed helper/installer TCB, callback inbox/signature, egress, abuse and independent reporting ports

gates.name: Separate exact sandbox preparation authorization
requiredEvidence: Exact owner-approved target/hash/tenant/account/actions/time/containment
Private credential custody and independently reviewed preparation outcome
gates.exit: No credential or preparation action authorized by this file

gates.name: Genuine bounded hosted token and capture acceptance
requiredEvidence: Separately authorized provider-hosted token and exact immutable source intent
Redacted actual approval/decline/loss/timeout evidence
Independent concurrent duplicate and changed-key denial evidence
Strict actual response validation without parser weakening
gates.exit: An ambiguous result remains UNKNOWN; no second charge

gates.name: Independent reports, callbacks and settlement comparison
requiredEvidence: Separate exact read-only report and bounded callback authorization
Raw-body signature/digest, event/account binding and replay/dedup evidence
Retained report identity/hash/as-of, delayed/out-of-order evidence
Exact transaction and independent settlement matching, unresolved discrepancies retained
gates.exit: Callback success is not bank funding; equal net is not source reconciliation

gates.name: Separate settled refund acceptance
requiredEvidence: Separate authority for exact original settled capture and same tenant/customer/invoice/merchant
Bounded amount and outstanding refund capacity
Actual immutable refused/lost/partial result and independent reconciliation
gates.exit: No void, ACH, recurring, vault-reuse, full-refund shortcut or provider fallback

gates.name: Accountant, legal/tax and separate release acceptance
requiredEvidence: Independent gross/fee/tax/refund/dispute/net/bank-deposit and chart mapping review
Suspense, UNKNOWN and cutoff exception disposition
Processor/legal/tax/surcharge/payroll review
Separate complete Release 1.0 workflow/security and explicit owner launch authorization
gates.exit: No commercial, legal, tax, provider or launch acceptance is claimed
